## Review checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/TheHalfMoon/Orcel/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and scoped this change narrowly.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed, or explained why not.
- [ ] I reviewed security/approval boundaries and documented any changed risks.
- [ ] I confirmed no secrets, personal data, or private machine paths are included.
- [ ] I checked third-party licenses, notices, and permissions for new dependencies/assets.
- [ ] I did not rewrite historical evidence, release checksums, or provenance.
- [ ] I documented unsupported checks and remaining limitations rather than claiming completion.

## Interface or documentation changes

For public UX/branding changes, link a sanitized screenshot or SVG preview. For documentation, identify which source-of-truth pages were updated.

## Compatibility and release impact

Does this affect Windows packaging, installation, update/rollback, the MCP tool surface, trust policy, protected state, or published identifiers? If so, explain the migration and regression qualification required.

> Reviews follow the repository's existing CI and governance requirements. A green check does not itself publish a release.
